events.title: A horde survivor that plays your music
events.summary: it's a horde survivor. You know the genre, walk, the horde comes, you pick upgrades, you get stupidly strong. Here's the twist. Weapons don't have a fire rate, they fire on the beat of the music. Enemies spawn on the downbeat and move in rhythm. Hit an ability within the beat and it crits for double. Its a horde survivor that plays your music.If that's your kind of thing, wishlisting now genuinely helps.Thanks for reading this far. More devlogs coming roughly every 2 weeks between now and launch
